approved: Fair Work Amendment (Protecting Weekend Pay and Penalty Rates) Bill 2017

The Greens introduced the Fair Work Amendment (Protecting Weekend Pay and Penalty Rates) Bill 2017 to block the Fair Work Commission’s penalty rate cuts for young and low-paid workers, arguing weekend and public holiday rates are essential for living wages. The bill would prevent rates from falling below their start-of-2017 levels, and the Greens challenged Senators Hinch, Xenophon and Hanson to support it.
